comparison.method: Two separately copied project directories were generated in independent Python processes; all four declared STEP outputs were compared byte-for-byte.

repair: Project-local audits derive the project path from their own file and use a relocation-safe fit fallback instead of searching for .workshop-product-run-root.
Review-only per-part color metadata was removed from the single-color combined assembly because its presentation-style ordering changed otherwise identical STEP bytes between fresh processes.
evidence_limit: Byte reproducibility and digital CAD checks do not prove printer-process fit, a successful physical print, elastic force, fatigue, wear, or human response.
